svg.title: FilmSwipe
svg.desc: FilmSwipe: Tinder-style film matching with friends, for Android. What it does: Discover popular and trending films from the TMDB API. Swipe right to like and left to pass, with a smooth card stack. Create a room and share its code; when both people like the same film, a Cloud Function declares a match. Quick Duel pairs you with a random player instantly, with real-time chat in every room. Offline watchlist with Room, and an ad-free upgrade through Google Play Billing. Built with: Kotlin, MVVM, Hilt, Coroutines & Flow, Retrofit, Room, Firebase Realtime DB, Firebase Auth, Cloud Functions, Navigation, Glide, Lottie, CardStackView, AdMob, Play Billing.
